target.description: Exact environment, entity, prefab, asset, animation or registered tool ID, a new environment name, a model search phrase for spawn_asset, or an empty string as required by the tool

name.description: Prefab name of 1 to 48 characters for save_prefab, empty for other tools

preserve_rig.description: True only for spawn_asset when the user requests a rigged model

clip.description: New clip for preview_animation, null for other tools

behavior.description: Settings for set_behavior, null to remove the behavior or for other tools

changes.description: Requested prop properties for spawn_prop, spawn_asset, edit_entity or duplicate_entity. Null leaves an existing property alone or uses the spawn default.

position.description: Exactly three coordinates in metres in the current scene, or null for an aimed spawn or unchanged position

color.description: Six RGB hex digits without #, or null

name.description: Prop display name of at most 64 characters. Empty restores its default name.

target_entity.description: Exact door ID for a door behavior, or an empty string

settings.description: Numeric settings from the catalog. Empty uses defaults.

duration.description: Loop length in seconds, from 1 to 30

keyframes.description: 2 to 10 ordered keys from zero to duration. Match endpoints, with whole turns allowed for rotation.

offset.description: Three local offsets in metres, each within -2 to 2. Zero for companion.

rotation.description: Three local Euler angles in degrees, each within -720 to 720. Zero for companion.

pose.description: Two companion Lift and Drift weights within -1 to 1. Zero for props and for clips with joint tracks.

joint_tracks.description: Up to 16 rig joint tracks. Empty for unrigged props or companion Lift/Drift clips.

keyframes.description: 2 to 10 ordered keys. The first is at zero and the last at duration, with matching rotations.

rotation.description: Three local Euler angles relative to rest in degrees, each within -180 to 180
